items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Remember George Simon the writer? [INTERVIEWEE] Of course.

ctx.x: and don’t give them to anybody else. But you can have whatever I’ve got.” Now that’s a pretty — which they sent me stuff that I still have today and now I have the whole library. But so that was pretty interesting. And then I went back to the band three or four times. And you know like Corky would be playing and he’d be having a problem with the trumpet section, Harry’d go, “Why don’t you get a hold of Fred and see if he can come out and help us out for three or four days” you know. And then when Harry ever came…
